title: Everyday Phrases — Visiting a Museum
scene_zh: 參觀博物館 · 情境對話
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏛️ 實用參觀博物館必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Visiting a Museum
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用參觀博物館情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從查開放時間、線上訂票、領圖租導覽，到看恐龍化石、買明信片與約下次特展，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Visiting a Museum phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering opening hours, online tickets, audio guides, dinosaur fossils, the souvenir shop and planning the next special exhibit. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do the doors open?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 九點，但排隊很早就開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 假日的開放時間會改嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 等等，週五會開到很晚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the east one, it has fewer people.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ði ist wʌn, ɪt hæz ˈfjuər ˈpipəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many hours should we plan?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three hours is plenty for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, it saves the line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pick a time slot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, choose ten in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I check out with my phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tʃɛk aʊt wɪð maɪ foʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 買票時能用手機付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I show at the gate?
dialogue.phonetic: /wət du aɪ ʃoʊ æt ðə ɡeɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我收到的郵件確認了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we change the date later?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只能在那個時段之前改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about tickets that skip the line?
dialogue.phonetic: /wət əˈbaʊt ˈtɪkɪts ðæt skɪp ðə laɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours already skips the long line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the line be long anyway?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a student ticket?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Saturday one of the free days?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈsætərˌdeɪ wʌn ʌv ðə fri deɪz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不，只有每月第一個週日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids under six come in free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free day tickets still need booking?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, free tickets fill up fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I buy the family pass?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It costs less for four people.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we carry our backpacks inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Large bags must go to check.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the bag check desk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left side, right past the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phones can stay with us, right?
dialogue.zh: 手機可以留在我們身上吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, small items stay with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we eat in the halls?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this is my claim ticket?
dialogue.zh: 那這張就是我的取件憑條？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many stops do we pass?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 五站，然後是博物館廣場站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which exit is closest to us?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exit C faces the main gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The train comes every six minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will be there before ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The park is near the museum, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑrk ɪz nɪr ðə mjuˈziəm raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 公園就在博物館旁邊吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wear shoes you can stand in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我那雙軟底的準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we just two for this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mia joins us at the gate.
dialogue.zh: 米婭在大門跟我們會合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Must groups book a guide first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our entry time is almost here.
dialogue.zh: 我們的入場時段快到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are saved on my phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I have a floor map?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this map come in Chinese?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is in the folder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which halls are on floor one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Looks like the east wing is closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊks laɪk ði ist wɪŋ ɪz kloʊzd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too bad, that is the Egypt room.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bæd, ðæt ɪz ði ˈidʒəpt rum./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we get a bigger print map?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi ɡɛt ə ˈbɪɡər prɪnt mæp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I leave my passport here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the guide have English audio?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I change the number?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type the piece number, then play.
dialogue.zh: 輸入展品編號，再按播放。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask staff for a fresh one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I return it at the exit?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ rɪˈtɜrn ɪt æt ði ˈɛɡzɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, drop it in that bin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up to floors three and four.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it runs to floor two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lift is for wheelchairs first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, which floor is the dinosaur?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi, wɪtʃ flɔr ɪz ðə ˈdaɪnəˌsɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，恐龍廳在哪一樓？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second floor, past the big window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we find the Asia gallery?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du wi faɪnd ði əˈʒiə ˈɡæləri?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the restrooms near this hall?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This sign points to the exit only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs saɪn pɔɪnts tə ði ˈɛɡzɪt ˈoʊnli./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look for the blue arrows inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take photos in here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about filming a short clip?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why no photos in that room?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I post my picture online?
dialogue.zh: 我能把照片傳到網上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No tripods, I read that sign.
dialogue.zh: 不能架腳架，我看到牌子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I sit on this bench?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Park it by the coat rack.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The coat rack is already full.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the hooks near the stairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to be quiet here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə bi ˈkwaɪət hɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't lean on the glass case.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will step back a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which room is a must-see today?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ rum ɪz ə mʌst si təˈdeɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The new wing has one famous piece.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nu wɪŋ hæz wʌn ˈfeɪməs pis./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How crowded is the new wing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 早上清靜，十二點後人多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we revisit the same hall?
dialogue.zh: 同一個廳能再看一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 憑你這張票今天可再進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This badge says trainee on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you work here or visit?
dialogue.zh: 你在這裡工作還是參觀？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does the free tour begin?
dialogue.phonetic: /wət taɪm dʌz ðə fri tʊr bɪˈɡɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that tour run in English?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sign up for it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many people join a tour?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About twelve, so it stays small.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This lobby feels like a market.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The map shows a quiet room here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæp ʃoʊz ə ˈkwaɪət rum hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 地圖上這裡有間安靜室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, we can rest our feet.
dialogue.zh: 不錯，可以讓腳休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the shop sell these maps?
dialogue.zh: 商店裡也賣這種地圖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the garden open in rain?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My audio guide just went dark.
dialogue.zh: 我的導覽器剛剛黑屏了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the button for five seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's head up to floor two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look how tall this dinosaur is!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In a desert far to the west.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ə ˈdɛzərt fɑr tə ðə wɛst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did it eat, do you know?
dialogue.phonetic: /wət dɪd it it, du ju noʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 小恐龍就是從裡面孵出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The label says a plant eater.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See the tiny teeth up close?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This painting is huge in person.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The colors are still so bright.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A woman artist, in seventeen ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the picture so dark?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，同一個世紀留下來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The small room has portraits only.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, used for grain and oil.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did they make this vase?
dialogue.zh: 這只花瓶是怎麼做出來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gold does not rust, you know.
dialogue.zh: 你知道嗎，黃金不會生鏽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The plaque text is very small.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app shows it much bigger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you read this label for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju rɛd ðɪs ˈleɪbəl fər mi?/
dialogue.zh: 能幫我讀這張說明牌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says, gift from a sailor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did this piece come from?
dialogue.zh: 這件展品是從哪兒來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From a coast town in Peru.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a careful copy of it.
dialogue.zh: 不是，是一件精製複製品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scan this code to hear more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 掃描要用到我的流量嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My scan did not work here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the number on the label.
dialogue.zh: 試試輸入牌子上的編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, it ends in the next room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən, ɪt ɛndz ɪn ðə nɛkst rum./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kids zone is down that hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɪdz zoʊn ɪz daʊn ðæt hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 兒童區沿那條展廳走到底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This table lets you build pots.
dialogue.zh: 這張桌子能自己做陶罐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can take yours home later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need an apron for her?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ən ˈeɪprən fər hɜr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They give one at the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This screen maps the old city.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Touch it to see one street.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is this case so cold?
dialogue.zh: 這展櫃裡為什麼這麼冷？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One is worth a month's pay.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 以前的人在這個上面寫字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is a stone letter.
dialogue.zh: 對，這是一封刻在石頭上的信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you read those old words?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 得靠著旁邊的譯文才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This sword has a curved blade.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A gift for a young prince.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it was made for burial.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why are so many pieces broken?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼這麼多展品是殘的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 時間會弄壞東西，真可惜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can still see the lines.
dialogue.zh: 裂過的線還是看得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This room is my favorite so far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs rum ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt soʊ fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 這廳是我目前最喜歡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine has softer light for art.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只挑三件最喜歡的就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This map shows an old trade road.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs mæp ʃoʊz ən oʊld treɪd roʊd./
dialogue.zh: 這地圖畫的是古代商路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 香料就是那樣運過來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The audio says a ship sank here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔˌdioʊ sɛz ə ʃɪp sæŋk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 講解說這裡沉過一艘船。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did they lift these stones?
dialogue.zh: 這些石頭是怎麼舉起來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lights move inside this case.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows the cloth's woven pattern.
dialogue.zh: 那樣才看得出布的織紋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A guide is explaining over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He tells great stories about kings.
dialogue.zh: 他講國王的故事真精彩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I could listen for an hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much time did we spend here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ taɪm dɪd wi spɛnd hɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs are so tired now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The café is on floor one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the café need a ticket?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you can enter from outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two seats by the window, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I get to drink?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hot chocolate is good here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有沒有低咖啡因的咖啡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ask for the blue cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a cheese plate?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just split the bill, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst splɪt ðə bɪl, ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cards, or do they take cash too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrdz, ɔr du ðeɪ teɪk kæʃ tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I refill my cup once?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they have a kid's menu?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the café open after close?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shop is before the exit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have postcards of the dinosaur?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈpoʊstˌkɑrdz ʌv ðə ˈdaɪnəˌsɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rack near the register has them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ræk nɪr ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstər hæz ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 收銀台旁那個架上就有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take four or five?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they sell the big poster?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I write here and mail it?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ raɪt hɪr ənd meɪl ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我能在這寫好直接投遞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a box by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə bɑks baɪ ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, buy them at the counter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a tote bag?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this copy of the art good?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ˈkɑpi ʌv ði ɑrt ɡʊd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card for this?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ baɪ kɑrd fər ðɪs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please put these in a box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a receipt, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 請寫上我們公司的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They type it at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I show my passport?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the refund window, floor one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get cash or card back?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ɡɛt kæʃ ɔr kɑrd bæk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time is our meeting point?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I lost Mia in the crowd.
dialogue.zh: 我在人群裡跟丟了米婭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call her, I am by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl hɜr, aɪ æm baɪ ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone has no signal here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們錯過了最後那個廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 票可以再進場，還進得去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The metro is packed at six.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's take the next train home.
dialogue.zh: 我們搭下一班地鐵回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the special hall open today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we came on the wrong week.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, wi keɪm ɑn ðə rɔŋ wik./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們這週來得不巧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They show a new exhibit next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ʃoʊ ə nu ɪɡˈzɛbɪt nɛkst mʌnθ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love maps, count me in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we come on a school trip?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi kʌm ɑn ə skul trɪp?/
dialogue.zh: 能跟學校旅行一起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That pays for two visits already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 會員還能收到導覽邀約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we come back in spring?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, spring has a big show.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you enjoy the museum today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my feet hurt, but it was worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, maɪ fit hɜrt, bət ɪt wʌz wɜrθ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 開心，腳雖然痛，但很值得。
